verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe self-hosted/BYOC deployment of the full LlamaCloud platform, including LlamaParse and LlamaExtract, on Kubernetes via Helm charts on AWS, Azure, or GCP, keeping data, models, and infrastructure under the customer's control. The enterprise-readiness page also lists single-tenant, BYOC, self-hosting, and regional endpoints. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and explicit detail on air-gapped/on-prem (non-hyperscaler) operation and whether self-hosting is gated to enterprise licensing.
